design.parent_grouping: payload+interval; all requested-power/duration/seed/fault variants share parent

limitations: same analytical law, not physical independence or validated coverage
validation/evaluation are benchmark roles, not new calibration permission
zero-severity controls share baseline evidence, not independent observations
scoring_protocol: Week12 only; freeze harness/model/policies before final labels. Keep all related parent variants together. ABSTAIN/ERROR blocking is not positive fault detection. Report undetected faults, control false alarms and control abstention blocks separately; never optimize on locked outcomes.
